parent.title: A weekend in Villaverde de Pontones, anchored on Cenador de Amós

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Cenador de Amós
siblings.summary: A 30 km radius around Villaverde de Pontones covers Santander city, the Cabárceno wildlife park, two surf-reserve beaches, anchoa producers in Santoña, and the Pasiego village of Liérganes — enough for a long weekend without ever exceeding a 30-minute drive.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Cenador de Amós
siblings.summary: Jardines Villaverde is literally next door to Cenador de Amós — book it. Three other rural posadas sit within a 15-minute walk if it's full.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Cenador de Amós
siblings.summary: Nine palaces, casonas and posadas within a 25-km / ≈€45 night-taxi radius of Cenador de Amós — ranked by distance and character.

sources.title: ViaMichelin — Villaverde de Pontones → Santander
sources.claim: Driving distance from Villaverde de Pontones to Santander is roughly 23 km, around 17 minutes by car.

sources.title: Distancias entre ciudades — VdP → Santander
sources.claim: Straight-line distance between Villaverde de Pontones and Santander is ~10.58 km, road distance ~23 km.

sources.title: XXXV ACEDE 2026 — official
sources.claim: XXXV ACEDE International Conference runs 14-16 June 2026 at the University of Cantabria, Santander, on the theme 'Responsible Governance and Business Transformation in the Age of Artificial Intelligence'.

sources.title: XVII TAEE 2026 announcement (UPV/DIEO)
sources.claim: XVII TAEE International Conference (electronics teaching and technology) is scheduled 1-3 July 2026 at ETSIIT, University of Cantabria, Santander.

sources.title: Caña Digital 2026 — CEOE-CEPYME Cantabria
sources.claim: Caña Digital 2026 is an 8-session free tech-talk + networking series from 23 April to 17 December 2026.

sources.title: C-Meet — official
sources.claim: C-Meet is Cantabria's annual digital-innovation event held at Escenario Santander over two days each autumn.

sources.title: C3 — Centro de Ciberseguridad de Cantabria — CTF events
sources.claim: The Centro de Ciberseguridad de Cantabria (C3) runs recurring Capture-The-Flag (CTF) competitions at PCTCAN.

sources.title: Gobierno de Cantabria — SODERCAN C3 programme
sources.claim: SODERCAN runs a free awareness and training programme at the C3 cybersecurity centre on Torre Xtela (PCTCAN).

sources.title: GDG Santander — community page
sources.claim: GDG Santander hosts sporadic developer meetups; the most recent listed is 'Generative SDUI: Orquestando Interfaces Dinámicas con Flutter' on 29 May 2026.

sources.title: CERN Indico — Quantum Computing Master Class @ UC
sources.claim: The University of Cantabria's Facultad de Ciencias hosted a CERN International Quantum Computer Masterclass on 14 April 2026.

sources.title: CantabRobots — CITED Cantabria
sources.claim: CantabRobots + Math 2026 was held 14 May 2026 at the Palacio de Exposiciones de Santander with 1,500+ K-12 students.

sources.title: PINN Cantabria — innovation agenda
sources.claim: Cantabria's PINN (innovation hub) lists Caña Digital, CantabRobots, ACEDE 2026 and TAEE 2026 in its 2026 agenda.

sources.title: PCTCAN — Cantabria Science & Technology Park
sources.claim: PCTCAN hosts 82 tech-based companies and ~4,800 employees and provides venues for industry-tech events.

sources.title: Clúster TERA — Cantabria ICT association
sources.claim: Clúster TERA is Cantabria's ICT industry association and a co-organiser of Caña Digital.

sources.title: CISE — STARTinnova programme
sources.claim: CISE runs ongoing entrepreneurship programmes including STARTinnova and e2 from its Santander base.
